content: MAST taxonomy (arXiv 2503.13657, 1600+ annotated traces, 7 frameworks): 14 failure modes in 3 clusters — system design/specification issues ~41.8% (task misinterpretation, ambiguous roles, poor decomposition, duplicate roles, missing termination conditions), inter-agent misalignment ~36.9% (communication breakdowns, context loss at handoffs, conflicting outputs, format mismatch), task verification failures. Key insight: failures are organizational-design failures, not just LLM limitations; better models alone will not fix flawed org structure.
